---
title: "Analyzing NBA Recruits"
author: "Mariana Comartin"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
#| label: inspect-nba-recruits

nba_recruits <- read_excel("data/nba_recruits.xlsx")
glimpse(nba_recruits)
```

```{r}
#| label: summarize-nba-recruits

nba_recruits |>
  select(rank, nba_mean_ws48, top_mean_wa, total_seasons, drafted) |>
  summary()
```

```{r}
#| label: count-basketball-tiers
#| cache: true

basketball_tibble <- nba_recruits |>
  mutate(
    tier = factor(
      tier,
      levels = c(
        "Never played", "Brief career", "Solid career",
        "All-Star level", "Superstar"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    recruit_group = factor(
      recruit_group,
      levels = c(
        "#1–10", "#11–25", "#26–50",
        "#51–100", "Outside top 100"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: career-tier-by-recruit-group

basketball_tibble |>
  filter(!is.na(rank), !is.na(top_mean_wa)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rank, y = top_mean_wa, color = tier)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  geom_label(
    data = basketball_tibble |>
      filter(
        !is.na(rank),
        !is.na(top_mean_wa),
        name %in% c(
          "LeBron James", "Kevin Durant", "Anthony Davis",
          "James Harden"
        )
      ),
    aes(x = rank, y = top_mean_wa, label = name),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Recruit rank",
    y = "Peak Wins Added",
    color = "Career tier"
  )
```
